explanation: In 1874 the critic Louis Leroy seized on Monet's Impression, Sunrise to mock the whole exhibition. The painters soon adopted the insult as their name.

claims.text: The term Impressionism comes from Claude Monet's painting Impression, Sunrise, through a critic's mocking review.
The term Impressionism does not come from a painting by Manet, Degas or Renoir.
In 1874 the critic Louis Leroy used the title of Monet's Impression, Sunrise to mock the exhibition in a satirical review.
The painters later adopted the name Impressionists themselves.
